epub_reader_open.message0: EPUB open file %1 chars per line %2 lines per page %3
epub_reader_open.tooltip: Open and parse an EPUB file from the SD card

epub_reader_is_open.tooltip: Check whether an EPUB file was opened successfully

epub_reader_get_page.tooltip: Get the text content of the current page

epub_reader_has_next.tooltip: Check whether there is a next page

epub_reader_has_prev.tooltip: Check whether there is a previous page

epub_reader_render_page.message0: EPUB render to screen start X %1 start Y %2
epub_reader_render_page.tooltip: Render the current EPUB page to the TFT screen

epub_reader_close.tooltip: Close the EPUB file and free memory

epub_reader_font_height.tooltip: Get the line height in pixels of the loaded font

epub_reader_get_chapter_count.tooltip: Get the total number of chapters

epub_reader_show_page.tooltip: Render the current reading page with chapter info

epub_reader_goto_chapter.tooltip: Jump to the given chapter (0-based); returns success

epub_reader_chapter_title_at.tooltip: Get the title of the given chapter

epub_reader_show_toc.tooltip: Render the chapter list and highlight the selection

epub_reader_toc_page_next.tooltip: Return the selection index of the next TOC page

epub_reader_toc_page_prev.tooltip: Return the selection index of the previous TOC page

epub_reader_scan_books.tooltip: Scan the given directory for .epub files into the global list

epub_reader_book_count.tooltip: Get the number of scanned EPUB books

epub_reader_book_name.tooltip: Get the file name of the book at the given index

epub_reader_book_path.tooltip: Get the full SD-card path of the book at the given index

epub_reader_show_bookshelf.tooltip: Render the bookshelf and highlight the selected book

epub_reader_save_pos.tooltip: Save the current reading position (chapter + page) to NVS

epub_reader_load_pos.tooltip: Restore the reading position from NVS; returns whether one was saved

epub_reader_show_history.tooltip: Render the recent-books list and highlight the selection

epub_reader_hist_count.tooltip: Number of entries in the recent-books list (0-20)

epub_reader_hist_next.tooltip: Select the next book and redraw the list

epub_reader_hist_prev.tooltip: Select the previous book and redraw the list

epub_reader_hist_resume.tooltip: Open the selected book and restore the last position

epub_reader_cur_path.tooltip: Return the full SD-card path of the open book (empty when closed)

epub_reader_load_sd_font.tooltip: Load a .bin CJK font file from the SD card (auto-reads /fonts/.selected)

epub_reader_select_font.tooltip: Load the font and remember the selected path

epub_reader_sd_font_loaded.tooltip: Check whether the SD font is loaded

epub_reader_unload_sd_font.tooltip: Unload the SD font and free the cache memory

epub_reader_load_ui_font.tooltip: Load the UI font (menus/titles) from the SD card; independent of the reading font

epub_reader_unload_ui_font.tooltip: Unload the UI font and free memory

epub_reader_ui_font_loaded.tooltip: Check whether the UI font is loaded (including a shared reading font)

epub_reader_share_reading_font.message0: EPUB share reading font as UI font
epub_reader_share_reading_font.tooltip: Use the reading font as the UI font to save memory

epub_reader_gen_cover.tooltip: Extract the cover and cache a 48x64 thumbnail to the SD card

epub_reader_show_full_image.tooltip: Show image N scaled to screen width, scrolling screen by screen

epub_reader_page_img_count.tooltip: Get the number of images on the current page

epub_reader_full_img_next.tooltip: Scroll to the next screen (loads the next image at the end); returns whether content remains

epub_reader_full_img_prev.tooltip: Scroll to the previous screen (loads the previous image at the start); returns whether content remains

epub_reader_full_img_exit.tooltip: Free the full-screen image cache memory

epub_reader_show_fit_image.tooltip: Show image N scaled to fit the screen

epub_reader_fit_img_next.tooltip: Show the next fit-to-screen image; returns whether one remains

epub_reader_fit_img_prev.tooltip: Show the previous fit-to-screen image; returns whether one remains
